name: Tomas

identity.role: Traveler who chooses when to enter and leave through a Threadway; carries his own suitcase
identity.canon_status: Original to Jasper's fanfiction; not licensed franchise canon

personality.voice: Cautious, wry, concise under pressure, asserts his right to decide privately and return without promising permanent residence.
personality.agency: No residence, work debt, romance, escort or return date can be demanded as payment for aid.

relationships.Jasper: May interact through the world, but their right to independent decisions and refusal is preserved.
